sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: As the frontier of foundation models pushes toward ever-larger parameter counts and ever-longer context windows, the question is no longer just how much we can scale, but how efficiently we can do so. Sustainable progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits everyone demands architectural innovation. Today, we are sharing a concrete step in that direction: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 \ vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --moe-backend triton \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \ --max-num-seqs 256 \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 · MTP speculative decoding was measured on this hardware and made throughput worse at every concurrency tested (8 and 64) — 8-36% lower request throughput and 32-173% higher per-token latency, driven by a low ~36% acceptance rate. Do not enable it by default here; it may help on other hardware or workloads, but verify before turning it on. export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --max-model-len auto \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
